text:
Maya (Finance): Hi team — ACME reported that a $15k promo credit they expected on Feb invoice is missing. They were charged reserved capacity in us-west-2 but credits aren't showing up on that invoice. Can someone sanity-check ledger flows?

Ekai (Infra): tagging infra because this smells like region tagging during commit application. Did the Dedicated commit get created with a region override? @Infra-SRE

Infra-SRE: I pulled the commit rows — looks like the reserved-capacity contract was created as `reserved-us-west` but the credits were issued to `reserved-us-east` (typo on onboarding form). Ledger entries: `commit-9876: 2026-11-01, region=us-west, acct=acct-ACME` vs `promo-333: 2026-11-01, region=us-east, acct=acct-ACME`.

Samir (Billing): Yikes. If credits applied to `reserved-us-east` and there's no matching cost in that subacct for the period, the system automatically consumed them against any outstanding reserved ledger in that subacct. That would make them not visible on the us-west invoice.

Maya (Finance): Do we have a safe way to reassign the promo to the us-west invoice retroactively? Customer is asking for a corrected invoice.

Tia (Accounting): We can do a journal adjustment, but need a clean audit trail. Prefer to reallocate at ledger level then issue corrected invoice. What does billing team recommend?

Samir (Billing): We have an internal tool to reallocate credits. Command below (only ops+billing can run):
```
/billing reallocate --promo-id promo-333 --from-subacct reserved-us-east --to-subacct reserved-us-west --amount 15000 --reason "promo-region-mismatch" --dry-run
```
Run dry-run first to see affected invoices.

Olivia (CS): ACME is getting anxious. Can we confirm an ETA? They want the corrected invoice before month-end.

Infra-SRE: Dry-run shows invoice 2026-11-30 (us-west) would receive a $15k credit; invoice 2026-11-30 (us-east) would be debited the same. No net change to company revenue, just reallocation.

Samir (Billing): After dry-run sign-off from Finance+Accounting+Infra, we can run the real command which will create two ledger adjustments and flag both invoices for regeneration. It should take ~30-45 mins to process and then accounting will confirm the journal entry.

Maya (Finance): Approved. Tia, can you sign off on the journal once reallocation completes? I will notify ACME.

Tia (Accounting): Will sign. Please attach the support thread and dry-run output to the journal entry.

billing-bot: Action queued: reallocation-dryrun-1795504321 created by Samir. Use `/billing status reallocation-dryrun-1795504321` to follow progress.

Samir (Billing): Running dry-run now, posting output shortly.

Samir (Billing): Dry-run output pasted: `affected_invoices: ["INV-ACME-US-WEST-20261130 (+$-15000)", "INV-ACME-US-EAST-20261130 (+$15000)"]`, `ledger_entries_created: ["adjust-17955-a","adjust-17955-b"]`. Looks clean.

Maya (Finance): Good. Proceed with real reallocation when you have a maintenance window. Keep CS looped in.

Samir (Billing): Reallocation executed at 1795504620. Created journal id J-202611-ACME-179550. Invoices regenerated.

Olivia (CS): ACME confirmed they received corrected invoice and appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:

Tia (Accounting): Journal posted and reconciled. Closing on our side.

Maya (Finance): Thanks all. Action item: add a validation in the onboarding flow to require region/subacct parity for promo issuance to avoid this class of errors. Filing a follow-up ticket.

Ekai (Infra): I'll take the ticket to infra. Suggested check: block promo creation if subacct.region != commit.region unless `force-region-override` flag present.

Maya (Finance): Perfect — assign to Ekai and mark high priority. Thread closed.
